assumptions: No clinical model or history definition approved.
Concrete categories and no-treatment extensions require owner review.
Original oral-formulation reference categories do not establish patient route.
source_comparison: See source_diff and source_comparison_details for every retained node/state/ordered parent, removed dose node/edge, 19 original missing distributions versus 13 existing lookup definitions, no-treatment candidate state extensions and application-policy overrides. Original BN SHA pinned and unchanged.
explicit_graph: Fixed 31-node nature-only graph; source_comparison_details.retained_variables lists every source/derived ordered parent. All metadata-only proposed_parent dependencies are materialized as GIVENs except the removed dosing edge. Edges are modeler-synthesized review candidates, not established causal facts.
reference_table_provenance: reference_table_audit.cells enumerates all 286 printed Table-6 medication/side-effect symbols with exact Markdown line/column and original lookup definition. All match preserved categorical rows. Synthetic no-treatment reference rows map NotApplicable. The remaining 18 distributions are explicitly uncalibrated synthetic mathematical references, not source-backed clinical probabilities; complete clinical table provenance remains a release blocker.
estimation_instructions: prompt.txt requires all CPTs including roots, percentage strings, fixed order and empty evidence.
result_mapping: template.json defines concrete state-specific response, functional, tolerability, safety and monitoring review language plus explicit no-treatment discussion. Every queried state has a deterministic candidate wording branch; all distributions remain visible. No threshold/argmax/automatic treatment choice exists. Clinical branch selection/rendering remains S45 and owner review.
numerical_examples: examples.json contains two complete independently worked 31-node mathematical references. The asymmetric fixture gives AdherenceDifficulty Present 0.334 with an ordered-parent transpose guard and all review-output marginals. The no-treatment fixture gives 21 sentinel marginals 1.0 while independent urgent/monitoring concerns and flags retain 0.2; opposing context never clamps. These validate math/engineering only; clinical expected_for_review cases remain unapproved.
clinical_examples: examples.json contains 7 clinical review candidates: two differing established-treatment contexts, known no-treatment with explicit sentinels and four required uncertainty cases (unknown, not_assessed, missing, conflict). These are proposed readiness/scope/wording expectations, not self-validating clinical tests or implemented runtime claims.
admission_measurements: Measured 31 nature nodes, 1318 rows, 4509 cells, 132111 compact CPT payload bytes and 69782 effective XML bytes per full fixture. All 5 package tests passed in 6.87 seconds: asymmetric 2 inference + 1 replay took 4.09 seconds combined; no-treatment 1 inference + 1 replay took 2.72 seconds combined. Independent ordered-parent marginal 0.334, 21 sentinel marginals 1.0 and parallel safety/monitoring concern probabilities 0.2 passed within 1e-6; contrasting provenance never clamps. Memory ceiling/provider capacity remain unmeasured and clinical release is blocked awaiting review.
open_assumptions: Candidate 9-field history and source-backed treatment definitions, no-treatment graph/mapping consistency, descriptive2–4week initial-response window versus individualized alternative, medication reconciliation/unsupported contexts, source-formulation limitations, full clinical CPT provenance and final wording all require review before release. History v1, runtime projections/readiness and active bundles remain unchanged.
